newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay expects to cancel 16 flights.
newsitem.headline: Cathay expects to cancel 16 flights.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd said it is cancelling six flights out of Hong Kong and expects to cancel a further 10 flights returning to the territory on Saturday due the suspension of its 11 Airbus Industrie A330-300 aircraft.
"There will be six cancellations out of Hong Kong and we expect 10 cancellations returning to Hong Kong," a spokeswoman for the airline told Reuters.
Destinations of the cancelled flights from Hong Kong included Seoul, Tokyo, Taipei and Jakarta, she said.
Some other flights were being rescheduled due to the aircraft suspension, she said, but gave no further details.
Earlier on Saturday, Cathay said it had suspended operations of its 11 A330-300 aircraft due to concerns about the reliability of their Rolls-Royce Trent 700 engines.
